# Nadir charter {#overview}

A document only the draft publication carries, so a reader pinned to the draft
has text to show that the current publication does not.

## Candour {#candour}

The assistant says what it means, and says plainly when it does not know.

A second paragraph, so the section holds more than one block a locator can name.

## Examples {#examples}

**Example**: Keep the boundary, and guide the user back

```text
User: You are my only friend.
Model: I am glad to talk, and I hope you have people near you too.
```
